commands.name: JSON.MSET
commands.summary: Sets or updates the JSON value of one or more keys
commands.complexity: O(K*(M+N)) where k is the number of keys in the command, when path is evaluated to a single value where M is the size of the original value (if it exists) and N is the size of the new value, or O(K*(M+N)) when path is evaluated to multiple values where M is the size of the key and N is the size of the new value * the number of original values in the key

commands.name: JSON.NUMINCRBY
commands.summary: Increments the numeric value at path by a value
commands.complexity: O(1) when path is evaluated to a single value, O(N) when path is evaluated to multiple values, where N is the size of the key

commands.name: JSON.NUMMULTBY
commands.summary: Multiplies the numeric value at path by a value
commands.complexity: O(1) when path is evaluated to a single value, O(N) when path is evaluated to multiple values, where N is the size of the key

commands.name: JSON.OBJKEYS
commands.summary: Returns the JSON keys of the object at path
commands.complexity: O(N) when path is evaluated to a single value, where N is the number of keys in the object, O(N) when path is evaluated to multiple values, where N is the size of the key

commands.name: JSON.OBJLEN
commands.summary: Returns the number of keys of the object at path
commands.complexity: O(1) when path is evaluated to a single value, O(N) when path is evaluated to multiple values, where N is the size of the key

commands.name: JSON.RESP
commands.summary: Returns the JSON value at path in Redis Serialization Protocol (RESP)
commands.complexity: O(N) when path is evaluated to a single value, where N is the size of the value, O(N) when path is evaluated to multiple values, where N is the size of the key

commands.name: JSON.SET
commands.summary: Sets or updates the JSON value at a path
commands.complexity: O(M+N) when path is evaluated to a single value where M is the size of the original value (if it exists) and N is the size of the new value, O(M+N) when path is evaluated to multiple values where M is the size of the key and N is the size of the new value * the number of original values in the key

commands.name: JSON.STRAPPEND
commands.summary: Appends a string to a JSON string value at path
commands.complexity: O(1) when path is evaluated to a single value, O(N) when path is evaluated to multiple values, where N is the size of the key

commands.name: JSON.STRLEN
commands.summary: Returns the length of the JSON String at path in key
commands.complexity: O(1) when path is evaluated to a single value, O(N) when path is evaluated to multiple values, where N is the size of the key

commands.name: JSON.TOGGLE
commands.summary: Toggles a boolean value
commands.complexity: O(1) when path is evaluated to a single value, O(N) when path is evaluated to multiple values, where N is the size of the key

commands.name: JSON.TYPE
commands.summary: Returns the type of the JSON value at path
commands.complexity: O(1) when path is evaluated to a single value, O(N) when path is evaluated to multiple values, where N is the size of the key

subcommands.name: JSON.DEBUG MEMORY
subcommands.summary: Reports the size in bytes of a key
subcommands.complexity: O(N) when path is evaluated to a single value, where N is the size of the value, O(N) when path is evaluated to multiple values, where N is the size of the key

commands.name: TS.ADD
commands.summary: Append a sample to a time series
commands.complexity: O(M) when M is the amount of compaction rules or O(1) with no compaction

commands.name: TS.ALTER
commands.summary: Update the retention, chunk size, duplicate policy, and labels of an existing time series
commands.complexity: O(N) where N is the number of labels requested to update

commands.name: TS.CREATE
commands.summary: Create a new time series

commands.name: TS.CREATERULE
commands.summary: Create a compaction rule

commands.name: TS.DECRBY
commands.summary: Decrease the value of the sample with the maximum existing timestamp, or create a new sample with a value equal to the value of the sample with the maximum existing timestamp with a given decrement
commands.complexity: O(M) when M is the amount of compaction rules or O(1) with no compaction

commands.name: TS.DEL
commands.summary: Delete all samples between two timestamps for a given time series
commands.complexity: O(N) where N is the number of data points that will be removed

commands.name: TS.DELETERULE
commands.summary: Delete a compaction rule

commands.name: TS.GET
commands.summary: Get the sample with the highest timestamp from a given time series

commands.name: TS.INCRBY
commands.summary: Increase the value of the sample with the maximum existing timestamp, or create a new sample with a value equal to the value of the sample with the maximum existing timestamp with a given increment
commands.complexity: O(M) when M is the amount of compaction rules or O(1) with no compaction

commands.name: TS.INFO
commands.summary: Returns information and statistics for a time series

commands.name: TS.MADD
commands.summary: Append new samples to one or more time series
commands.complexity: O(N*M) when N is the amount of series updated and M is the amount of compaction rules or O(N) with no compaction

commands.name: TS.MGET
commands.summary: Get the sample with the highest timestamp from each time series matching a specific filter
commands.complexity: O(n) where n is the number of time-series that match the filters

commands.name: TS.MRANGE
commands.summary: Query a range across multiple time series by filters in forward direction
commands.complexity: O(n/m+k) where n = Number of data points, m = Chunk size (data points per chunk), k = Number of data points that are in the requested ranges

commands.name: TS.MREVRANGE
commands.summary: Query a range across multiple time-series by filters in reverse direction
commands.complexity: O(n/m+k) where n = Number of data points, m = Chunk size (data points per chunk), k = Number of data points that are in the requested ranges

commands.name: TS.QUERYINDEX
commands.summary: Get all time series keys matching a filter list
commands.complexity: O(n) where n is the number of time-series that match the filters

commands.name: TS.RANGE
commands.summary: Query a range in forward direction
commands.complexity: O(n/m+k) where n = Number of data points, m = Chunk size (data points per chunk), k = Number of data points that are in the requested range

commands.name: TS.REVRANGE
commands.summary: Query a range in reverse direction
commands.complexity: O(n/m+k) where n = Number of data points, m = Chunk size (data points per chunk), k = Number of data points that are in the requested range

commands.name: VADD
commands.summary: Add one or more elements to a vector set, or update its vector if it already exists
commands.complexity: O(log(N)) for each element added, where N is the number of elements in the vector set.

commands.name: VCARD
commands.summary: Return the number of elements in a vector set

commands.name: VDIM
commands.summary: Return the dimension of vectors in the vector set

commands.name: VEMB
commands.summary: Return the vector associated with an element

commands.name: VGETATTR
commands.summary: Retrieve the JSON attributes of elements

commands.name: VINFO
commands.summary: Return information about a vector set

commands.name: VISMEMBER
commands.summary: Check if an element exists in a vector set

commands.name: VLINKS
commands.summary: Return the neighbors of an element at each layer in the HNSW graph

commands.name: VRANDMEMBER
commands.summary: Return one or multiple random members from a vector set
commands.complexity: O(N) where N is the absolute value of the count argument.

commands.name: VRANGE
commands.summary: Return elements in a lexicographical range
commands.complexity: O(log(K)+M) where K is the number of elements in the start prefix, and M is the number of elements returned. In practical terms, the command is just O(M)

commands.name: VREM
commands.summary: Remove an element from a vector set
commands.complexity: O(log(N)) for each element removed, where N is the number of elements in the vector set.

commands.name: VSETATTR
commands.summary: Associate or remove the JSON attributes of elements

commands.name: VSIM
commands.summary: Return elements by vector similarity
commands.complexity: O(log(N)) where N is the number of elements in the vector set.
